rv.q: The entire production has an eerie, engulfing quality thanks to Es Devlin's picture-perfect diorama of a set.
Bewitching, beguiling, and brilliant - The Crucible is a must-see.
A magnificent revival, with a strong ensemble. Even if you've seen The Crucible before, it's always worth another trip.

All that water that falls periodically in this production of The Crucible isn’t for the purposes of the ‘swimming test’, where women accused of being witches were bound up and tossed into an open body of water, and if they sank they were human but if they floated they were a witch.
It's a watchable production of a great play, but it could have been so much more.
It is the performances of the older characters that shine out.
